text.p: Motorola Inc said Tuesday its Platform Software Division unveiled Memos, an open software operating environment for the wireless industry.
All product components of Memos are designed and targeted for personalized mobile messaging, Motorola said.

Motorola said Memos was adopted and will be incorporated into products developed by its communications businesses, including General Systems Sector, Land Mobile Products Sector and the Messaging, Information and Media Sector. The platform will also be offered to the communications industry-at-large.

"As a leading device manufacturer in the wireless communications industry, Motorola believes the establishment of standard software platforms will further expand the market, which is beneficial to the industry-at-large," Doug Kraul, vice president and general manager of Motorola's Platform Software Division, said in a statement released from Atlanta.
